verdict.rationale: Galileo is an evaluation and observability platform with an in-product AI Assistant, so letting users connect MCP servers as a client is a plausible capability to ask about. The evidence only documents Galileo's own MCP server, which exposes Galileo's features to IDEs like Cursor and VS Code. That is the server role, not the ability to plug external MCP servers into Galileo, and nothing in the pack shows Galileo consuming MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
